heroSummary: The Bambu Lab A1 Mini can push eSUN ABS+ up to 214 mm/s at an 18 mm³/s volumetric limit, but its open-frame design and 80°C bed cap make it prone to severe warping without external mitigation. Reliable printing requires a draft shield or makeshift enclosure alongside high-adhesion bed prep to overcome thermal contraction on this bed-slinger.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate + PVP Glue Stick or Bambu Liquid Glue
slicerTweaks: Cap Maximum Volumetric Speed at 18 mm³/s and set Nozzle Temperature to 250°C with Bed Temperature pinned to 80°C maximum.
Enable Draft Shield with height set to 100% or add an exterior Brim of at least 8-10 mm with 0 mm brim-object gap.
Lower Part Cooling Fan thresholds to 0% min and 15% max, disabling fan completely for the first 4 layers to prevent delamination.
Set First Layer Speed to 30 mm/s and First Layer Line Width to 0.5 mm to enhance base squish and bed adhesion.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: The A1 Mini bed maxes out at 80°C, which is below ABS+ ideal glass transition heating, combined with open-air convective cooling.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Apply a generous coat of liquid glue or glue stick, use a 10 mm brim with zero offset, and block ambient room drafts with a cardboard partition or tent enclosure.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Excessive cooling fan speed and cold air currents striking the part during rapid bed translation on the Y-axis.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Set cooling fan to 0% for standard printing (max 15% on short layers) and enable the OrcaSlicer Draft Shield feature.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Extruder Clicking and Underextrusion on Top Layers
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Moisture absorption causing filament boiling/steam expansion in the meltzone, or printing beyond volumetric flow limit.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dry eSUN ABS+ spool at 70°C for 6 to 8 hours before printing and ensure Maximum Volumetric Speed does not exceed 18 mm³/s.

faq.question: Can I safely print eSUN ABS+ on an open-frame A1 Mini?
faq.answer: Yes for small to medium parts, but you must prevent drafts using a draft shield or tent, as ambient airflow will cause warping and cracking.

faq.question: Why is the bed set to 80°C when eSUN recommends 90°C-105°C?
faq.answer: The Bambu Lab A1 Mini has a firmware and hardware safety limit of 80°C on the heated bed, requiring strong bed adhesives like PVA/PVP glue to compensate.

faq.question: Do I need to swap to a hardened steel nozzle for eSUN ABS+?
faq.answer: No, eSUN ABS+ is an unfilled modified polymer and is non-abrasive, making the stock stainless steel nozzle completely suitable.

faq.question: Does eSUN ABS+ emit toxic VOC fumes during printing?
faq.answer: Yes, ABS+ emits styrene and ultrafine particles; ensure the printer is located in a well-ventilated space or paired with an active carbon air purifier.
